tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The travel firm should have registered in the State of Karnataka.
The firm shall be responsible for all the costs associated with the preparation, submission and opening of tenders.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should furnish documents related to the vehicles make and model of the cars proposed to be allotted to ACIWRM along with copies of RTO Registration, Insurance, Emission test document, Karnataka State Taxi permit & driving license with badge etc of the vehicles for verification.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As specified in tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The contractor should provide proof for owning/lease at least 3 vehicles in the name of contractor/service provider. For proof for owning/lease vehicle in the name of the contractor should submit attested Xerox copy of RTO Registration, Insurance, Emission test document, Karnataka State Taxi permit & driving license with badge etc. Owned by the tenderer of all the 02 vehicles to be provided for verification. For leased vehicles should, submit lease agreement from owner of vehicles placing the car at the disposal of the tenderer. This agreement should be of tenure (minimum of two years) sufficient to cover this contract agreement.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As specified in tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have an average annual turnover of Rs 13.00 Lakhs in any 2 years the car rental business during the past 5 years (2021-2026).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should have an average annual turnover of Rs. 13.00 Lakhs per year in the car rental business in any two years during the past 5 financial years (2021-2026) and shall provide Documentary evidence, audit certificate and Income Tax returns in this regard.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should furnish list of Government Dept. and other customers with the contact address, Phone and e-mail address in ANNEXURE-2 to show similar services have been provided in previous years and should have supplied at least 02 cars to Karnataka State Government Departments PSUS in the past 2 years work done costing Rs. 6.5.00 Lakhs. A letter issued for having satisfactory services should be provided at least minimum one State/Central Government Offices.
